Directions by
Take KSRTC from Thrissur Town Bus Stand toward Round South. Alight at Temple Road — 2 minute walk to the gopuram.
Open transit route
Thrissur Railway Station is 3 km. Autos and cabs at the exit — approximately 10 minutes.
Open transit route
Via NH 544, take the Thrissur Round South exit. Parking inside the compound. Arrive before 8:30 AM.
Open driving route
Autos from Sakthan Thampuran Bus Stand. Ola and Uber available. Fare: approximately ₹40–80.
